# <span id="aanchor467"></span> Facility Editor

This functionality requires **Application Process – FLOWCAL Options** privileges and the Liquids or Gas add-on.

FLOWCAL allows users to specify "To" and "From" facilities on batches and rail tickets in order to track inventory values at each facility.

Use the Facility Editor to enter facility names that will then be available in areas throughout FLOWCAL, such as the Meter Editor (**Liquids** \> **Facilities** tab or **Integration** tab) and Ticket Editor (**Rail Car** \> **Accounting** tab).

<div class="procedure">

To create a new facility:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.

2.  Select **Facility** within the **Liquids** group.

3.  Click the **New** button.

4.  Enter a facility name at the bottom of the screen.

5.  Enter a facility code if needed (required for facilities designated as "Integrated").

6.  Designate the facility as a "From", "To", or "Integrated" facility by clicking the **Is From**, **Is To**, or **Integrated** checkboxes.

    A facility can be designated as a "To" , "From", or "Integrated" facility. If you do not specify the "From" and "To" designations, the facility will be available in both the **From** and **To** drop-down boxes. If the facility is designated as an "Integrated" facility, it can be selected in the Meter Editor Integration tab used for Quorum Enterprise Integration (i.e., FLOWCAL to TIPS). Integrated facilities cannot be deleted if the facility is associated with an integrated meter.

7.  Click the **Save** button.

When the "Create Facilities" FLOWCAL Configuration option is enabled, facilities can be automatically created on ticket import (TFX) if a "From" facility or "To" facility is in the file that is not in FLOWCAL.
